title: Combined Search and Encoding for Seeds, with an Application to Minimal Perfect Hashing
examined: Official full HTML; Section 1.1 UNI and Lemma 3. Root independently checked after investigator run.
supports: Existing shared-seed codebook mechanism attains information-scale storage with exponential work; joint seed improvements are not a contradiction to single-seed entropy.

title: The Bloomier Filter: An Efficient Data Structure for Static Support Lookup Tables
examined: Author-hosted full PDF, Section 3 and 3.3; local PDF/text/page image in this directory.
supports: Static support maps and valid-range decoding already relate acceptance probability to the size of an interval; not the identical seed-only construction.

title: An Optimal Bloom Filter Replacement
examined: Author-hosted primary PDF introduction and author publication list.
supports: AMQ definition permits a random superset with per-fixed-nonmember error probability; random realized FPR alone does not escape it.

title: Succinct Data Structures for Retrieval and Approximate Membership
examined: Primary PDF, Observation 1 and Theorem 1; root independently checked primary abstract/metadata.
supports: Retrieval-to-AMQ reduction and succinct constructions; no new originality follows merely from a seed reaching the information scale.

title: Ribbon: Fast Succinct Static Retrieval and Approximate Membership
examined: Publisher PDF introduction and Section 5.4; independent root and codec-review checks.
supports: Current succinct retrieval baseline and row-span exception for homogeneous filtering. No filter-runtime reproduction claimed.

title: Xor Filters: Faster and Smaller Than Bloom and Cuckoo Filters
examined: Primary author abstract and publication metadata only.
supports: Practical baseline beyond Bloom; benchmark figures are not reproduced or used as measurements of this project.

title: Binary Fuse Filters: Fast and Smaller Than Xor Filters
examined: Primary abstract and publication metadata; no full empirical replication.
supports: Modern practical comparison point; no measured performance claim in this triage.
